fix(export-html): blink holds still under reduced motion (rich-docs-examples-xuu.0hj) (#186)

* fix(export-html): blink holds still for a reader who asked for reduced motion (rich-docs-examples-xuu.0hj)

HTML_FRAGMENT_CSS redefines the rich-blink keyframes as empty under
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. The blink is an inline animation that no
stylesheet rule outranks, so emptying the keyframes it names is the one lever
the page has. Covers the docs outputs and every encodeHtml document.

* fix(export-html): gate the blink keyframes on no-preference instead of emptying them under reduce

One rule: nothing depends on a later same-named @keyframes winning, and a
minifier that drops empty rules cannot strip the reduced-motion half. The
browser test now covers blink2 and a preference switched on while the page is
open; a unit test pins the gate.
